identity.resolvedIdentity: The protected Rød manor house and immediate museum complex in Halden, with its historic interiors and collections, distinct from the full park, agricultural estate and generic Rød locality.
identity.identityProblem: Rød is simultaneously a main building, museum, park, farm and wider locality. The canonical record needs a precise physical anchor without reducing the historic complex to only one room or expanding the marker into a property boundary.
identity.splitReason: The main house and its museum identity form one coherent destination. The park and garden structures remain components of the same visitor complex, while separate facilities can retain their own identities.
